from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import math
import re

repo = Path.cwd()
paths = sorted([*repo.glob('agents/*.md'), *repo.glob('commands/*.md'),
                *repo.glob('agent-kits/shared/*.md'), *repo.glob('agent-kits/dev-cycle/references/*.md')])
pattern = re.compile(r'SHAREDKIT=(?:"\$\(find [^\n]*?-path \'\*agent-kits/shared\'[^\n]*?head -1\)"|\$\(find [^\n]*?-path \'\*agent-kits/shared\'[^\n]*?head -1\))')
policy = ('Resuelve shared una vez por pieza y conserva su procedencia. Reasigna la ruta absoluta '
          'observada a SHAREDKIT en cada bloque shell nuevo; no presupongas variables persistentes. '
          'Sin kit conserva los fallbacks; no cambies de bundle durante la ejecuci\u00f3n.\n\n')
reassign = "SHAREDKIT='<ruta-shared-observada>'"
rows = []
est = lambda t: math.ceil(len(t) / 4)
for p in paths:
    text = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    matches = list(pattern.finditer(text))
    if not matches:
        continue
    # One safe standalone resolution per piece; each former call remains runnable
    # in a fresh shell after the agent substitutes its actual observed route.
    candidate = policy + '```bash\n' + matches[0].group() + '\n```\n\n' + pattern.sub(reassign, text)
    rows.append({'path': p.relative_to(repo).as_posix(), 'occurrences': len(matches),
        'source_lf_sha256': hashlib.sha256(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
        'before_estimate': est(text), 'candidate_estimate': est(candidate),
        'candidate_delta': est(candidate) - est(text)})
by = {r['path']: r for r in rows}
scenarios = {
    'quick-default-known-fragments': ['commands/dev-cycle.md', 'agents/implementer.md', 'agents/qa.md', 'agents/documenter.md', 'agent-kits/shared/capability-check.md'],
    'full-flow-known-fragments': ['commands/dev-cycle.md', 'agents/evaluator.md', 'agents/planner.md', 'agents/implementer.md', 'agents/qa.md', 'agents/documenter.md', 'agent-kits/shared/capability-check.md'],
    'only-pieces-with-local-duplicates': [r['path'] for r in rows if r['occurrences'] > 1],
}
report = {'task': 'T-17', 'date': '2026-10-30', 'baseline': 'fbbf181',
    'estimate': 'ceil(characters/4), not API/tokenizer consumption',
    'candidate': {'policy': policy, 'reassignment': reassign,
        'construction': 'Prepend one full six-root original resolution and policy; replace each original assignment with an explicit observed-route assignment. Preserve each original first lookup, including setup jobs exclusion; all other prompt text unchanged.'},
    'rows': rows, 'total_occurrences': sum(r['occurrences'] for r in rows),
    'pieces': len(rows), 'duplicate_pieces': sum(r['occurrences'] > 1 for r in rows),
    'scenarios': {name: {'readset': readset, 'added_estimate': sum(by[p]['candidate_delta'] for p in readset if p in by)} for name, readset in scenarios.items()},
    'limits': ['Scenario deltas, not absolute complete dev-cycle token consumption', 'All unchanged fragments cancel out of comparison', 'A shared fragment could change this cost but requires explicit cross-piece provenance/partial-install handling and a new validated readset', 'No claim that every shorter future design is impossible'],
    'production_changes': False}
p = repo / 'docs/roadmap/2026-10-27-plugin-optimization/testing/t17-resolution-decision.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ['total_occurrences','pieces','duplicate_pieces','scenarios']}, indent=2))
print([(r['path'],r['candidate_delta']) for r in rows if r['occurrences'] > 1])
